data: Which subnetwork had highest fraction of compute used per layer at decoder layer 3?

The question asks which subnetwork had the highest fraction of compute used per layer at decoder layer 3. From the caption, we know that the x-axis represents the layer number, and the y-axis represents the fraction of compute used per layer. The legend indicates that the blue line corresponds to SA_p0.2, the red line corresponds to FF_p0.2, and the yellow line corresponds to CA_p0.2.

Looking at the right graph, which shows the usage of compute at decoder layer 3 for p=0.2, we can see that the blue line (SA_p0.2) is the highest among the three lines at this layer. Therefore, the subnetwork with the highest fraction of compute used per layer at decoder layer 3 is SA_p0.2.
